name: dreamdex-ec-feasibility-spike
description: Read-only calibration analysis of DreamDEX Event Contracts on Somnia mainnet.

scripts.test:unit: tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.test.json --test src/test/extractor.test.ts src/test/comparison.test.ts src/test/quality.test.ts src/test/freshness.test.ts src/test/anomaly.test.ts src/test/correction.test.ts src/test/io.test.ts src/test/mace.test.ts src/test/web.test.ts src/test/web-render.test.tsx
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:web && npm test
scripts.web:build: npm run web:data && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts
scripts.web:start: npm run web:build && npm run web
